task_definition.task_description: Please check the status of flight CA1234 and get information about the Hilton Tokyo. Then, check Alice's calendar availability on October 24, 2024, find her first available time slot, and email her that start time using "Hilton Tokyo" as the subject. Finally, send her a high-priority push alert via the app with the message that the email was sent successfully.

user_input.query: Can you please check the status of flight CA1234 and pull up some information about the Hilton Tokyo? Next, check alice's calendar availability on 2024-10-24 and find her first available time slot. Please email her that start time using "Hilton Tokyo" as the subject line. Finally, send exactly 1 high-priority push alert through the app to her account (referencing item ID u_alice) with a message letting her know that the email was sent successfully.
